name: Punch
author: Peter Berkenbosch
description: Fast time tracking in the Omarchy bar: one pill that is the running timer, a keyboard quick switcher, and a day panel.

barWidget.description: Running timer in the bar. Left opens the day panel, right starts or stops, middle opens the quick switcher, scroll cycles recent projects.

schema.label: Ask about idle time after (seconds)
schema.description: Notify when you come back from being away this long while the clock ran. 0 turns idle detection off.

schema.label: Hide the pill when nothing is running
Show the project name in the bar
Round finished entries up to (minutes)
schema.description: 0 keeps exact durations. 15 rounds every stopped entry up to the next quarter hour.

schema.label: Push finished entries to Moneybird
schema.description: Needs moneybird-cli installed and logged in. Mapping lives in ~/.config/punch/moneybird.json.
